# THE RED DOG WATCH [italic]Night sightings around {colony}. Whatever it is, it is fast, it is red, and security says it is nothing.[/italic]
Started by a few of us on the late shifts after the third person in a fortnight came in from the outer plots white in the face and saying they had seen a dog. There are four registered dogs on {colony}. All four were indoors. So this is where we write it down.
[color=#D0582C][bold]/// 2 NEW SIGHTINGS THIS WEEK. BOTH NEAR THE SOUTH DRAINAGE. ///[/bold][/color]
## BOARD RULES - Time, place, light conditions, how far away. If you did not see it clearly, say so. Half of all sightings are a cargo tarp in the wind. - Tracks and marks: describe them, measure them against something everyone has, like a boot or a ration tin. - Do not go looking for it. Read the third pinned thread if you think you will. - Do not shoot at it near a fuel line, a pipe or a person. Read the pump house post in the first thread and you will see why. - Be kind to the skeptics. They are useful. They are also usually the ones who go looking.

## WHAT WE THINK WE KNOW [color=#8A7A62][italic]None of this is confirmed. All of it has been said by more than one person who did not know the others.[/italic][/color] - About the size of a big dog, low to the ground. Some say bigger. - Red to rust brown. Shiny, like a beetle shell, not fur. - A long head with no eyes anyone can find, and a long tail with a point on it. - No sound from it but hissing, and sometimes a clicking, like fingernails on a table. - Faster than anything on legs has a right to be. It clears a two metre fence without stopping. - Where it bleeds, or drools, or whatever it does, metal smokes.
